text: Greyson Clothiers, the Detroit golf-apparel brand founded in 2015 by its founder and CEO Charlie Schaefer, completed a $20 million Series A strategic growth-capital round in February 2025 that was led by NewBound Ventures and New Era CEO Chris Koch, with participation by Kendra Scott CEO Tom Nolan and Nautica founder David Chu; the release said Nolan, Chu and NewBound's Michael Hoffman would join its board.
short: Greyson Clothiers is founder Charlie Schaefer's private company; its 2025 Series A was led by NewBound Ventures.

source.name: PR Newswire: Greyson Clothiers Secures $20 Million in Strategic Growth Capital, Led by NewBound Ventures
source.quote: announces the successful completion of a $20 Million Series A strategic growth capital raise. This funding round was led by NewBound Ventures and Chris Koch, CEO of NewEra
source.note: The company's own release. The same release identifies 'Charlie Schaefer, founder and CEO' and says 'Founded in 2015, Greyson delivers elevated everyday pieces'; it says Tom Nolan, David Chu and NewBound's Michael Hoffman would join the board. Its full share register isn't public.
